items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and approve only existing period-aligned reconciliation. Authorize no discretionary spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or new production work. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row cannot be assigned to sites without inventing attribution; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods are misaligned; infrastructure, domain, labor, and marketing costs are absent; incremental outcomes are not isolated; and monthly spend, marketing, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Minimum measurement is one reconciled period-aligned ledger by site, page, and date covering attributable revenue, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, and marketing costs, plus experiment exposure and incremental outcomes. Treat impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, technical scores, and proposed CTR lift as operating indicators—not financial returns or supported forecasts. Continue only the existing finance reconciliation and preserve the candidate plan as deferred backlog.

Maintain financial containment. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row cannot be assigned to sites without inventing attribution; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Conflicting AI-cost records and missing aligned cost data prevent ROI, margin, payback, forecast, and spend decisions.
